nature_of_business: Compliance and Product Certification Consulting Firm
about: BIS Consultancy Services is an ISO-certified compliance and product certification consulting firm assisting manufacturers, importers, and exporters in obtaining approvals from the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and other Indian regulatory bodies. They manage standard identification, laboratory testing, documentation, application filing, and factory inspection readiness.

items: CRS Registration (Compulsory Registration Scheme for Electronics & IT)
QCO Compliance & Registrations for Toys, Footwear, Medical Textiles, and Furniture
EPR Tyre Waste & Used Oil Authorization

process: 1. Free Applicability Check: Identify applicable IS code, QCO order, or regulatory mandate.
2. Documentation: Prepare test requests, process flow charts, and factory setup files.
3. Lab Testing Coordination: Dispatch product samples to BIS-approved laboratories.
4. Application Filing: Submit verified applications on regulatory portals and follow up with officers.
5. Factory Audit Preparation: Provide on-site audit readiness support for ISI and FMCS schemes.
6. Grant of License: Hand over formal certification and manage routine renewals.
